description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Josef)] and [Monk Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Josef)
description.text: Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Monk abilities, causes [Imperil Ice 10% (5s)] after using equipped Monk abilities, grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after casting two equipped Monk abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [50% Critical (25s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Josef)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Josef)] from the user
